title: 全村公敌
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, pipa, plucked strings, tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
logline: Li Xiaokang backs the developer's share contract against the whole village; when the developer suddenly pays everyone more, he senses a trap.

clips.summary: At {loc}, {dahua} screams at {xiaokang} for betraying the village; {cunmin} calls him a traitor.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李小康，你是不是脑子有病！
cuts.say: 李小康！你是不是脑子有病？！
cuts.act: 双手叉腰，尖着嗓子破口大骂
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} jabs a finger toward the camera.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 说好联合起来让开发商涨价，你居然关键时刻背叛我们！
cuts.say: 说好联合起来让开发商涨价……你居然关键时刻背叛我们！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, right of centre; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, glaring at him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stands rigid, gripping the hem of his shirt, eyes down.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 我看他就是拿了开发商的好处！黄谷村不要叛徒，滚出去！
cuts.say: 我看他就是拿了开发商的好处！黄谷村不要叛徒——滚出去！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} flinches as the shout lands; his jaw tightens.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: The crowd chants at {xiaokang}; his inner voice says that day he became the village's enemy.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} alone in the dirt clearing of {loc}; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, encircling him, raising fists.
cuts.action: The villagers chant and shake their fists; {xiaokang} stands still in the middle.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame.
cuts.action: {xiaokang}'s knuckles whiten on his shirt hem; his eyes glisten.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 那一天，我成了全村的公敌。
cuts.say: 那一天……我成了全村的公敌。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile, the crowd a blur behind him.
cuts.action: His eyes drop to the ground.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

clips.summary: Earlier at {loc}: {gaoliang} sits behind the contract tables; {dahua} mocks his offer of fifty thousand and {cunmin} jeers.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {gaoliang} seated in a suit behind the folding tables stacked with contracts at {loc}, villagers crowding in front.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} straightens a stack of contracts, smiling politely.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 高总，拆一户才给五万，你打发叫花子呢？
cuts.say: 高总，拆一户才给五万……你打发叫花子呢？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang} seated at the table, centre frame.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} keeps his smile, eyes cold behind his glasses.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 五万能干啥？在你们城里怕是连个厕所都买不着！
cuts.say: 五万能干啥？在你们城里……怕是连个厕所都买不着！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {cunmin} demands more money and the crowd chants; {shoudi} looks around, embarrassed.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 必须加钱！不加我们不签！
cuts.say: 必须加钱！不加——我们不签！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {cunmin} slams his palm on the contracts.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the crowd at {loc}; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, pumping their fists around {cunmin}.
cuts.action: The villagers chant together, fists pumping.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.
cuts.sound: The crowd chants 加钱 in rhythm.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} among the crowd, off-centre; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {shoudi} glances around uneasily, shrinking into his jacket.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} stands and says the contract is already set; {dahua} says the land is theirs and nobody signs without more money.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 各位乡亲，合同早就定好了，现在这样不合适吧？
cuts.say: 各位乡亲……合同早就定好了，现在这样，不合适吧？
cuts.act: 站起身，面带微笑，慢条斯理
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} rises from his seat and buttons his jacket.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 我们黄谷村的地，我们说了算！不加钱，这合同我们就都不签了！
cuts.say: 我们黄谷村的地，我们说了算！不加钱……这合同，我们就都不签了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} lets the silence hang, studying the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} asks if nobody will sign the share contract; {xiaokang} pushes forward and says he will; his father {shoudi} is stunned.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 好，你们都不签原始股的合同是吧？
cuts.say: 好。你们……都不签原始股的合同，是吧？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} adjusts his glasses with one finger.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我签！我签原始股的合同！
cuts.say: 我签！我签原始股的合同！
cuts.act: 从人群里挤出来，鼓起勇气大声喊
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} shoves forward and raises his hand.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {shoudi}'s mouth falls open; he stares at his son.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 儿啊……你这是？
cuts.say: 儿啊……你，你这是？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} rounds on {xiaokang} for betraying them after his father paid for his schooling; {cunmin} sneers at him.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 好啊，李小康！你书都读到狗肚子里去了！
cuts.say: 好啊，李小康！你书都读到……狗肚子里去了！
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 关键时刻背叛我们，你装上大善人了？
cuts.say: 关键时刻背叛我们……你装上大善人了？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 亏你还是李守地的儿子，怎么这么有心眼？
cuts.say: 亏你还是李守地的儿子……怎么这么有心眼？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} pleads that the village can become a tourist spot and shares are worth more than cash; {dahua} and {cunmin} scoff.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 大家别急，先听我说！建成旅游景点，游客越多分红越多！
cuts.say: 大家别急，先听我说！建成旅游景点……游客越多，分红越多！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} opens both palms toward the crowd.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {dahua} rolls her eyes and looks away.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 钱是死的，股份是活的，长远看，还是股票更划算！
cuts.say: 钱是死的，股份是活的……长远看，还是股票更划算！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {dahua} wails that he will ruin them all; {cunmin} sneers that he must be the developer's bastard son.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 你懂个屁！读了两天书就觉得自己是个人物了？
cuts.say: 你懂个屁！读了两天书……就觉得自己是个人物了？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 没良心的玩意啊，这是要把我们都毁了啊！
cuts.say: 没良心的玩意啊……这是要把我们都毁了啊！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 我看他是高亮的私生子吧，不然怎么这么帮他！
cuts.say: 我看……他是高亮的私生子吧！不然怎么这么帮他！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {shoudi} shouts that Xiaokang is his own son; {gaoliang} raises his hand and announces fifteen thousand more per household; {xiaokang} is stunned.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你们别乱说话！李小康是我的亲生儿子！
cuts.say: 你……你们别乱说话！李小康是我的亲生儿子！
cuts.act: 急得满脸通红，声音发抖
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} steps in front of his son.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 好！那就依各位的诉求，每户再加十五万！
cuts.say: 好！那就依各位的诉求——每户，再加十五万！
cuts.act: 抬手示意安静，笑容满面，声音洪亮
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} raises his hand, then spreads it wide.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} freezes, staring at the businessman in disbelief.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: The crowd erupts; {dahua} crows that the boss is generous; {gaoliang} adds a condition: one worker per household stays to build the resort.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at {loc}: a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, jumping and clapping around {dahua}.
cuts.action: The villagers cheer and slap each other's backs.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 我就说嘛！高总是大老板，能差咱们这点？
cuts.say: 我就说嘛！高总是大老板……能差咱们这点？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} claps her hands over her head.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 不过，我有个条件：每户出一个劳动力，留下来建景区，工资另算。
cuts.say: 不过……我有个条件。每户出一个劳动力，留下来建景区——工资另算。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {cunmin} and {dahua} rush to sign; the villagers crowd the tables.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 还另算工资？那敢情好啊！
cuts.say: 还另算工资？！那敢情好啊！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 签签签！高总您放心，俺们干活最实在！
cuts.say: 签签签！高总您放心……俺们干活最实在！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the folding tables at {loc}: a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, jostling to sign the contracts, {dahua} at the front.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

clips.summary: Watching the signing, {xiaokang}'s inner voice says it is too easy; {shoudi} asks why he did not sign, and he says this contract must not be signed.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience at the signing site: a restless crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 所有人都觉得自己赚到了。可高亮答应得这么爽快，事情没那么简单。
cuts.say: 所有人都觉得自己赚到了……可高亮答应得这么爽快，事情，没那么简单。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile watching the signing tables.
cuts.action: His eyes narrow at the signing tables.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 儿啊，你怎么没去签字？
cuts.say: 儿啊……你怎么没去签字？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，你相信我，这合同不能签！
cuts.say: 爸，你相信我……这合同，不能签！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns to his father and holds his gaze.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.
